metadata.name: Sediment Core Analysis Dataset
metadata.description: This dataset contains sediment core analysis data including various chemical and physical properties such as Total Organic Carbon (TOC), Black Carbon (BC), Calcium Carbonate (CaCO3), pH, grain size distribution, and metal concentrations (Pb, Zn, Cu). The data also includes isotopic measurements (δ13C, δ15N) and magnetic susceptibility. The samples are from two boreholes (BH-II and BH-rec) with coordinates and elevation provided.
